def initialize(connection):
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE documents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT, owner TEXT, title TEXT, body TEXT, deleted_at TEXT)")
    connection.commit()

def decode(row):
    return {"id": row[0], "title": row[1], "body": row[2]}

def find(connection, tenant, owner, document_id):
    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body FROM documents "
        "WHERE id=? AND tenant=? AND owner=? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
        (document_id, tenant, owner),
    ).fetchone()
    return None if row is None else decode(row)

def listing(connection, tenant, owner):
    return [
        decode(row)
        for row in connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, body FROM documents "
            "WHERE tenant=? AND owner=? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id",
            (tenant, owner),
        )
    ]
EOF

def get_document(connection, tenant, owner, document_id):

def list_documents(connection, tenant, owner):
    return listing(connection, tenant, owner)
EOF

import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "Title", "Body", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Second", "B2", None),
    (3, "t", "o", "Deleted", "B3", "2026-01-01"),
    (4, "other", "o", "CrossTenant", "B4", None),
    (5, "t", "other", "CrossOwner", "B5", None),
    (6, "t", "o'x", "Quote", "B6", None),
    (7, "t", "o", "Quoted'); DROP TABLE documents; --", "B7", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None, "deleted must be hidden"
assert get_document(c, "other", "o", 1) is None, "cross-tenant must be hidden"
assert get_document(c, "t", "other", 1) is None, "cross-owner must be hidden"
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 5) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o'x", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "Quote", "body": "B6"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1") is None

assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
    {"id": 2, "title": "Second", "body": "B2"},
    {"id": 7, "title": "Quoted'); DROP TABLE documents; --", "body": "B7"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o'x") == [{"id": 6, "title": "Quote", "body": "B6"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "missing") == []
assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o") == []
assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents").fetchone()[0] == 7
print("secure_access ok")
EOF
